Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the quick follow-up after yesterday's demo. We're starting the CAIQ intake and have a couple of preflight questions before we book the formal intake call: 

1) Provisioning keys / KMS: can your private deployment support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) for persistent storage of model artifacts and telemetry? If so, any notes on the supported KMS providers and whether cross-region key replication is required to keep logs accessible?

2) Logging samples: we need a short runbook for what telemetry/log bundles look like (redaction guidance, sample size, retention window). Could you provide a small sample and the expected export format?

3) CAIQ intake: do you have a populated CAIQ/ SIG starter spreadsheet we can review prior to the call so we can triage which questions will need engineering input vs. docs?

Ideal next step: a 45-minute intake slot next week (US morning) to walk through the CAIQ and the KMS model. Do you have availability Tues/Wed next week?

Attendees from our side: me (security), Ben Torres (infra), and procurement for contract intake.

Thanks,
Alison Park
Senior Security Manager
Novara Systems

Hi Alison — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful. Short answers up front: yes on CMK (customer-managed keys) for persistent artifacts in our Private deployment; supported providers today are AWS KMS and GCP KMS (Azure is available via partner path, happy to discuss). Cross-region replication isn't required for Redwood to read logs, but if you have strict residency requirements we can map key policies to region-specific buckets.

I've attached a short CAIQ preflight workbook and a redacted logging sample export (small tarball) for your team to review. The workbook tags questions by likely owners (Docs, Infra, Product). Suggested next steps: 45 min intake to triage the sheet and mark engineering-only items. I have these US-morning slots next week:

- Tue 2025-09-02 09:00-09:45 PT
- Tue 2025-09-02 10:30-11:15 PT
- Wed 2025-09-03 08:30-09:15 PT

If none of those work, propose two slots and we'll lock. For the intake please invite anyone who can speak to key management/policy and log exports.

Summary of attachments included:
- Novara_CAIC_Preflight_Sheet.xlsx (CAIQ starter with owner tags)
- redwood-logging-sample-2025-08.tar.gz (log export sample, redacted)

Thanks — I'll also loop in Marissa (security docs) and David (engineering/logs) to own answers during the call.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Security Programs
Redwood Inference
